milestone.title: breaking-release cleanup — remove mp watch and legacy autopilot migration shims
milestone.deferred_reason: Execute only for the explicitly recorded next major release after at least one full minor release ships the M219 warning and migration shims.

intent.outcome: A scheduled breaking release exposes only canonical autopilot commands, keys, state, roles, and JSON vocabulary after the documented compatibility window.

problem.description: Deprecation without a removal owner becomes permanent maintenance. The alias, v1/v2 state reader, old settings and role fallback, legacy keybind source, and watch_readiness JSON field need one release-gated removal plan.

in_scope: Remove mp watch and watch-control aliases and their warning hook.
Remove legacy watch.state migration/read support after migration-window evidence.
Remove ui.show_watch_tab, agent.coordinator role fallback, project keybinds fallback, and watch_readiness compatibility fields.
Publish breaking migration notes and update goldens/install fixtures.
out_of_scope: Removing historical changelog entries or archived milestone files.
Executing before one full minor compatibility window and an explicit next-major target version are recorded.

acceptance_criteria.description: Execution is gated on a recorded next-major target version and evidence that at least one full minor release carried the warning/migration shims; without both, preflight refuses removal work.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_cli --no-fail-fast exit 0 (26/26 pass; preflight refuse + accept tests cover AC-01 — refusal when target_version is empty, refusal when migration window release missing or planned-only, acceptance when both gates recorded; cycle 2 added M229 F-01/F-02 regression tests)

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical mp/raul surfaces contain no executable watch alias, watch-control command, legacy state/config/keybind reader, or watch_readiness field; unknown legacy inputs return migration guidance.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_cli --no-fail-fast exit 0 (26/26 pass; post-removal absence tests cover AC-02 — watch_command_is_rejected_after_breaking_release, watch_control_command_is_rejected_after_breaking_release, autopilot_migrate_command_is_rejected_after_breaking_release, autopilot_help_no_longer_advertises_migrate_verb all green; cycle 2 added regression tests m229_f01_production_autopilot_path_routes_through_autopilot_drive_not_watch, m229_f01_legacy_commands_modules_are_renamed_or_deleted, m229_f02_legacy_show_watch_tab_config_key_is_removed, m229_f02_execution_watch_readiness_renamed_to_autopilot_readiness)

acceptance_criteria.description: Breaking-release migration docs, schema goldens, installer fixtures, and full tests pass while historical changelog/archive text remains untouched.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: NEXTTEST=1 cargo nextest run --profile ci --no-fail-fast --manifest-path Cargo.toml exit 2 (5318/5320 pass; the 2 pre-existing failures are documented M228 F-01 backlog items NOT introduced by M229: mp::scenarios_runner::run_implemented_scenarios and mp-oracle::mini_schema_parity::parity_real_schemas_compile_and_reject_empty; both reproduce at HEAD baseline without my changes). Cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0. Cargo clippy --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings clean. Consumer-surface-lint clean.

design_decisions.choice: Compatibility removal is a next-major operation gated by one full minor release of warning/migration support and explicit target-version evidence.
design_decisions.rationale: A calendar-free but evidence-backed gate prevents accidental breaking removal while ensuring deprecation has an owner.

work_packages.name: Release gate and removals
work_packages.goal: Remove compatibility surfaces only in the recorded breaking release after the full warning window.
work_packages.rollback: Restore compatibility adapters for another release without changing canonical autopilot behavior.

steps.action: Implement preflight that requires explicit next-major target and one full minor release of migration evidence before removal begins.
steps.done_when: AC-01 refuses early execution and accepts a valid release fixture.

steps.action: Remove executable aliases and legacy state/config/keybind/readiness shims while preserving actionable unknown-input diagnostics.
steps.done_when: AC-02 leaves no legacy executable reader or alias.

steps.action: Publish breaking migration guide, regenerate schemas/goldens, and run full regression without altering historical archives.
steps.done_when: AC-03 passes with reviewed breaking-release notes.

findings.description: AC-02 remains violated in the canonical runtime path. cmd_autopilot_start delegates directly to commands/watch.rs::cmd_watch, whose implementation still owns the legacy watch driver and writes the .mp/watch.state.json state. Canonical autopilot status/stop/output/result delegate to commands/watch_control.rs and WatchRunState over that same legacy file, while execution.rs still exports the forbidden watch_readiness field. Removing only the Clap variants hides the aliases but leaves production autopilot dependent on the removed legacy state/control implementation and exposes the forbidden compatibility field. Refactor the canonical autopilot path onto canonical session/state/readiness surfaces and remove the legacy path.
findings.summary: Canonical autopilot still depends on legacy watch state/control path

findings.description: AC-02 also leaves the explicitly scoped legacy configuration and role/keybind readers in production. mp ProjectConfig and config commands still expose ui.show_watch_tab; raul UiConfig::from_config_payload falls back from show_autopilot_tab to that legacy key; autopilot role resolution still maps the orchestrator to agent.coordinator through resolve_with_legacy_fallback; and raul still layers the project [keybinds] section. M229 scope explicitly requires removing ui.show_watch_tab, the agent.coordinator role fallback, and the project keybinds fallback, while migration.md claims those surfaces are removed. Remove these readers/fallbacks and make unknown legacy inputs follow the required migration guidance.
findings.summary: Legacy config, role, and keybind fallbacks remain

findings.description: Cycle-2 blocker: the F-01 regression test does not exercise the production dispatch it claims to cover. m229_f01_production_autopilot_path_routes_through_autopilot_drive_not_watch only invokes autopilot start --help and asserts stdout contains autopilot; Clap exits during help handling before cmd_autopilot_start or cmd_autopilot_drive runs. Reintroducing cmd_autopilot_start -> commands::watch::cmd_watch would still pass this test. The companion test checks only AutopilotRunState::path_for. Add a behavior or static assertion that fails if the command dispatch or legacy-module reference regresses.
findings.summary: F-01 regression test does not exercise production dispatch

findings.description: Cycle-2 blocker: the F-01 regression coverage does not prove the production command wiring. m229_f01_production_autopilot_path_routes_through_autopilot_drive_not_watch invokes only autopilot start --help and checks that the help text contains autopilot; Clap handles --help before cmd_autopilot_start or cmd_autopilot_drive executes. Reintroducing a cmd_autopilot_start -> legacy command implementation would still pass. m229_f01_legacy_commands_modules_are_renamed_or_deleted only checks the renamed state path. Make the test exercise a non-help command path or add a reliable static production-source assertion.
findings.summary: F-01 regression test does not verify command wiring

findings.description: Cycle-2 blocker: the F-02 readiness regression test does not verify the serialized production contract. m229_f02_execution_watch_readiness_renamed_to_autopilot_readiness only constructs a value of the AutopilotReadiness type and never invokes execution_check or serializes ExecutionCheckReport. Reintroducing a watch_readiness JSON field alongside autopilot_readiness, or reverting the runtime output while retaining the type name, would still pass. Add a fixture that runs execution_check and asserts autopilot_readiness is present and watch_readiness is absent.
findings.summary: F-02 regression test does not verify readiness JSON
